summary: A beauty salon in Emirates Tower appears to lose bookings to a free builder address, another business name in the footer and mixed contact numbers.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner at the top of the page.
findings.cost: A salon that charges for facials, keratin and lashes looks less established when the first thing a client sees is a builder advert.
findings.fix: Your own domain with the Wix banner gone.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say 2023 by Beauty & Co., created with Wix.com.
findings.cost: A client who reads another business name at the bottom may wonder if this is the right salon or a copied template.
findings.fix: Your salon name and the current year.

findings.problem: The page appears to list two phone numbers in the text, while the WhatsApp button uses a third number.
findings.cost: Clients are not sure which number reaches the salon, and a client who is unsure often books somewhere else.
findings.fix: One clear contact number and a clear WhatsApp booking button.

findings.problem: A SUMMER SPECIAL section appears to still be in the menu and on the homepage.
findings.cost: An out of season offer makes the page look unattended, and visitors may think the salon is not active.
findings.fix: A simple offers block you can change yourself.

redesign: One contact number and WhatsApp booking.
Offers you can update in minutes.
